tei:div.tei:p: 249) : chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: cho ga kun gyi cha lag las rim bdun pa bzhugs: 250)

na mo padma kā ra ye: rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa yis: rim gnyis lam mchog la 'jug nas: snying po'i don mchog thob pa'i phyir: cho ga zab mo nyams blang ba'i: thabs mchog rjes kyi las rim bstan: sa ma ya: dang po bskul pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs rnams: ma g.yel ma g.yel thugs dam gnad nas bskul: chos kyi dbyings nas gzugs kyi skur bzhengs la: log 'dren 'byung po bdud bgegs rdul du rlog: thugs dam dus la bab bo sa ma ya: gnyis pa chad mdo ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ dus gsum dus med ka dag dus kyi tshe: rang snang sku gsum ston pa'i spyan snga ru: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs shing: las bzhi'i phrin las sgrub pa'i pho nya ba: 'jig 'das dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas kun: chad mdo dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rab 'byams phrin las ma lus yongs 'grub mdzod: gsum pa bstan ma ni: hūm̐ bhyo: rig 'dzin chen po padma thod phreng gi: bka' dang dam tshig la gnas bod skyong sde: bstan ma ya ma skyong ma'i tshogs rnams kun: dpal 251) gyi bshal chu'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: mtha' mi kla klo'i bstan pa bsnub pa dang: zab chos bstan pa dar rgyas bstan 'dzin sde'i: tshe bsrings dus min bar chad kun sol la: bod khams bde la 'god pa'i phrin las mdzod: ma ma hriṃ hriṃ i daṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi: bzhi pa bro mnan ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ dpal chen 'khor bcas rngams pa'i bro: gnyis snang dam sri'i steng du brdung: ye shes rol pa'i rgyas btab bo: nam yang ldang bar ma gyur cig: oṃ laṃ: āḥlaṃ: hūm̐ laṃ: swā laṃ: hā laṃ: st+wam̐ bha ya nan: mchod bstod bya zhing: lnga pa bshags pa ni: hoḥ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gsan cing dgongs: bdag cag ma rig sgrib dbang gis: so thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi: sdom dang bslab pa dam nyams kun: mi 'chab mi sbed 'gyod pas bshags: tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol:

oṃ badzra satwa sa ma ya= sogs: āḥ lan gsum brjod nas: drug pa bsdu ldang ni: hūm̐ḥ thabs kyis bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: ye shes dbyings su badzra mu: rjes thob sgyu ma'i lha sku ni: rgyan dang 252)cha lugs rdzogs par bsgom: rtsa sngags mthar: badzra rakṣa rakṣa bhrūm̐: bdun pa bsngo smon ni: hrīḥ bskyed rdzogs rim gnyis dge tshogs kun: ma gyur 'gro ba yongs la bsngo: kun kyang rang rig mngon gyur nas: gzhon nu bum skur sangs rgyas shog: lan gsum brjod cing bkra shis sogs kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o: sa ma ya: de ltar rim gnyis lam brtson pa'i: rnal 'byor rnams kyi cha rkyen du: rjes chog zab mo'i lam rim 'di: zhi ba 'tsho yi dpal du sbyin: da dung ma spel dgongs rgyas thob: ma 'ongs 'dir 'phrad skyes bu ni: thugs kyi ming 'dzin khyim pa'i tshul: bka' srung dregs pa rnam gsum gyis: thub par srungs shig sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgyaḥ brda thim: : zhes pa 'di yang rang gi nye gnas yi ge'i 'du byed shākya'i dge btsun dam ldan tshul khrims rdo rje dang rigs kyi myu gu chos dbyings sgron ma sogs kyi gzhed ngor/ dus kun zhal brdzun mkhan su ba badzra gyis 'khrul snang las dag par phab pa dge'o//
